r14_95f29d0b_critic.text:
Comparing Holloway, Camden and Kentish Town for a King's Cross commute

Commute times (area reference points, door-to-door routing):
- Kentish Town: 22 minutes — the quickest of the three
- Holloway: 25 minutes
- Camden: 36 minutes

Time saved per week with the quickest option (Kentish Town):
- Versus Holloway: 25 − 22 = 3 minutes each way, so 3 × 2 = 6 minutes per day, and 6 × 5 = 30 minutes per week on a five-day commute.
- Versus Camden: 36 − 22 = 14 minutes each way, so 14 × 2 = 28 minutes per day, and 28 × 5 = 140 minutes per week (2 hours 20 minutes) on a five-day commute.

So the realistic weekly saving is modest against Holloway (about half an hour) and substantial against Camden (roughly two and a quarter hours), assuming five return trips a week.

Rent and value:
- Holloway: median £2250 pcm, range £1517–£3600 pcm, based on 30 cached listings (cache age 92 days).
- Camden: median £2100 pcm, range £850–£5000 pcm, based on 95 cached listings (cache age 48 days).
- Kentish Town: no rent data in the cached results, so I can't compare its cost — the search results don't cover this. Check rightmove.co.uk or zoopla.co.uk for current Kentish Town rents before deciding.

How the ranking falls out:
1. Holloway — best overall balance. Its 25-minute commute is nearly as fast as Kentish Town's, and it has solid rent evidence (median £2250 pcm) across a reasonable sample.
2. Camden — strongest on value in this data (lowest median of the two areas with rent figures, £2100 pcm, and the widest sample), but the slowest commute at 36 minutes.
3. Kentish Town — fastest commute at 22 minutes, but ranked last here only because there is no rent evidence to score it on. That is a data gap, not a verdict on the area.

Practical takeaway: if commute time is the priority, Kentish Town wins on paper but you need to price it yourself first. If you want a defensible all-round choice backed by actual rent data, Holloway is the pick — you give up only 3 minutes each way versus Kentish Town. Camden suits you if a lower median rent matters more than 14 extra minutes each way.

Caveats: these commute times are area-level reference points, not verified for individual homes, and the rent figures are mixed cached listings without room-type or bedroom filtering and are not live-verified.
